integrity: Claims are proved algebraically with a separate exact finite verifier. Source dates refer to publicly available background literature, not publication of this result. No independent audit, external certification, or priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional rectangular rook graphs are classified; the result does not assert a new algorithmic complexity bound or uniqueness among all published equivalent encodings. Exhaustive enumerations cover board dimensions two through five only; unrestricted assertions follow from the explicit bijection and algebraic proof. A previous equivalent P3-packing enumeration remains possible. Full text of UBC TR-2001-12 was not materially readable, although its dated abstract and distinctive incidence-graph object were inspected.
title: Induced and maximal induced matchings of rectangular rook graphs
